hooks.text: 白天建设经济与防线，夜晚亲自带兵抵御攻势，形成昼建夜守的紧凑循环。
hooks.excerpt: Thronefall is a minimalist strategy game where you build a humble kingdom by day and defend it by night. Balance economy and defense by fortifying walls, recruiting troops, and charging into battle yourself to protect your stronghold from relentless waves of attackers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十张地图分别改变地形、天气、敌人、建筑与挑战条件，让防守方案随地图变化。
hooks.excerpt: 10 Maps. From the mountainous Nordfels to the vibrant Wildbach, progress through a range of maps with different terrain, weather, enemies, buildings and challenges.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 五十余项可解锁特长中每局最多携带五项，还能加入变异条件主动抬高难度。
hooks.excerpt: Over 50 Unlockable Perks. Take up to 5 perks that bestow certain advantages, and optional Mutators to ramp up the difficulty.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩家选择受限，带来强烈惩罚感。

opinions.text: 无法用鼠标方便地选择并分配部队。

opinions.text: 首次游玩地图前无法知道将面对何种敌人。
